payload.package:
The artifact is the repository state on this iteration's branch, and it will be baselined by the close itself - the i5d close-and-merge split creates the tag iter/i8d-phone-brief BEFORE merging, so the evidence stays reachable at that tag while trunk receives only the live claims. That is the versioning mechanism for v2; there is no separate zip.

CONTENTS THIS ITERATION ADDS TO TRUNK (the live claims):
- engine/brief.ts - NEW. The sealed brief: seal/unseal with the layout contract, briefHtml, briefPage, publishBrief with confirm-before-announce, KvBriefStore, loadBriefStore.
- engine/phone.ts - rewritten. Absolute action URLs, gate-shaped card, three-action budget, per-announce transport, AnnounceResult, announce recording, and a transport that no longer swallows non-2xx.
- engine/wait.ts - the park seam.
- engine/tools.ts - the announcer wired into se_wait, and se_wait's description telling the truth about it.
- bin/se-board.ts - the announce timer REMOVED, the tap reader kept, the reason written in.
- tests/i8d-brief.test.ts - NEW, 19 checks.
- tests/i8-phone.test.ts - 6 constructor sites swept to the factory shape.
- Ledger: se.guidance-phone-setup rewritten, six decisions, seven RAID entries.

CONTENTS THAT STAY ON THE BRANCH (the record, withheld from trunk by the split): this iteration's evidence files, its machine drawings, its state.

CONFIGURATION BASELINE, stated because it is the part a reader will get wrong: the two machine-local config files - ~/.se/<project>/phone.json and ~/.se/<project>/brief.json - are NOT in the package and never will be. They hold secrets, they are per-machine by design, and the package works without them (silent, actions-only rung). The account, namespace, worker and token used in this iteration's live demonstration belong to the owner's Cloudflare account and exist outside the repository entirely.

ZERO new runtime dependencies. The crypto is node:crypto plus the platform's Web Crypto; the store is fetch. Nothing was added to package.json, which keeps the one-click install intact per the owner's ruling.
payload.entry_script:
NO NEW ENTRY SCRIPT, and this is a RECORDED SKIP rather than an omission.

The realization kind here is engine-ts inside an existing product that already has its entry: the MCP server is the one surface, started the way it already is, and this iteration adds no binary, no CLI and no new process. v2 has no CLI by design.

What a new owner needs instead of a script is a sequence, and it is documented rather than scripted because every step is either a click or an act only they can perform: (1) click the board's phone-connect tool and scan the QR with the ntfy app - the pairing writes itself; (2) OPTIONALLY drop brief.json beside it for the full-text brief; (3) that is all - the lane is live and silent until a run parks on a gate. Both steps live in se.guidance-phone-setup, which was rewritten this iteration for exactly this purpose.

Why not script step 2: it needs a Cloudflare account, a namespace and an API token, which are owner acts on a third-party service. A script that automated them would either need credentials it must not hold or would stop at the same place the documentation does. Automating the account setup was explicitly ruled OUT OF SCOPE at M4 and it stays out.

The verification entry that does exist and did run: the full battery, invoked by the engine's own verification state (run-86dadd78902a), plus the live chain demonstration (run-a8e537c05cac) which is deliberately NOT in the battery because it needs real credentials.
